scope: 60 previously eligible development problems; no protected material, corpus admission, model training or live deployment

legacy-expanded.rationale: Preserve mixed original20; expand with string, counting, membership and sequence scans. Not a pure semantic cluster.

array-matrix.rationale: Array/matrix transforms and numeric aggregation; no overlapping problem IDs with legacy-expanded.

exposure: All material comes from a previously authored/qualified development export. Original20 extensively used in prior literal experiments. New IDs and semantic categories were selected from export metadata before this freeze; no new selected source bodies inspected in this turn before split. This is development-heldback expressibility, not unseen generalization or autonomous synthesis.
split_rule: Original20 retained in fit; SHA256 gamma-literal-clusters-devheld-v1:ID orders added IDs; first8 of20 legacy additions and first4 of20 array/matrix are held back. Families are distinct by existing eligibility metadata; no claim family-disjoint semantics.
source_policy: Preserve original source bytes. Build normalized solve interface and deterministic binding canonicalization/AST extraction; bounded explicitly recorded semantic rewrite alternatives on fit only. Freeze generator/search/dictionaries before loading heldback source bodies; then apply frozen generic transforms and measure expressibility without retuning.
methods: AST-similarity-informed joint extraction and bounded merge/deletion
cost_policy: Flat LTD1 dictionary plus LTV1 packets; exactUTF8 strings,4–8bit IDs,41byte framing/program,padding; independent two-dictionary mode pays1cluster-selector bit/program and both dictionaryheaders; one merged dictionary has0cluster-selectorbits. No interactive controls exercised:0controlbits; navigation/finish/undo are not claimed free in UI. Metadata/sourcevariants/sharedcodec charged separately.
heldback_policy: Select/freeze candidates using fit-only metrics; no vocabulary additions, renaming changes or source rewrite tuning after heldback access. Report baseline and frozen-transformed expressibility separately; do not conflate original case checks with new source correctness.
